image.alt: 计划、执行、跟踪和复盘组成的四区微缩团队空间

brief.subject: A miniature team workspace with four functional zones: a planning board, two execution desks, a tracking board and a review meeting table. Seven expressive adult professionals interact in small groups.
brief.action: Two people arrange planning cards, two work at computers, one checks a progress board and two discuss the next cycle at a meeting table.
brief.structure: Four distinct work areas share one raised rectangular mineral base, linked by modest floor paths in the actual order planning, execution, tracking and review.
brief.details: Light oak desks, graphite frames, woven blue and sage chairs, unmarked task cards and detailed human faces. Sparse geometric boards, no raster labels or floating icon.
brief.composition: 16:9 landscape, 40-degree elevated near-orthographic view, complete mineral-composite base and contact shadow inside modest margins. Tactile realistic materials and expressive stylized adults; no text anywhere.

brief.subject: A team productivity diorama with an oak planning station, two compact execution desks and an adjacent review area, showing work at several different stages.
brief.action: Professionals inspect an unnumbered status board, complete desk tasks and discuss finished folders at the review table.
brief.structure: A shared raised base links the three work areas while distinct desk groups keep the status contexts visible; exact task counts belong only to the editable chart.
brief.details: Graphite frames, muted slate fabric chairs, sage storage trays and clear facial expressions; show geometric cards without encoding the adjacent numeric example.

brief.subject: A structured miniature office landscape containing a planning board, shared execution desks and a review table, with clearly different professional roles at each station.
brief.action: The planner organizes blank task cards, the contributors handle desktop work and reviewers collect completed folders.
brief.structure: Separate furniture groups define responsibilities on a continuous raised base; understated paths join the relevant roles without implying a reporting hierarchy.
brief.details: Neutral mineral surfaces, natural oak, graphite metal, muted coloured clothing and detailed expressive adults; keep each role visible with simple geometric devices.

brief.subject: A miniature handoff discussion with a seated pair exchanging a plain folder across an oak table and a standing professional presenting a modest geometric board.
brief.action: The receiving colleague takes the completed folder while listening to the discussion of remaining actions.
brief.structure: A single visible folder bridges the two seated roles, while the presenter connects the handoff to the review context, forming one coherent collaborative moment.
brief.details: Subtle stone texture, blue woven chairs, a quiet sage rug, unlabelled shelves and credible fingers and facial expressions; restrained plants at the perimeter.

brief.subject: A compact team delivery review diorama with three expressive colleagues, a shared oak table, an unmarked delivery folder and a secondary progress board.
brief.action: The colleagues compare the delivery folder with the review discussion and agree which follow-up actions should be recorded.
brief.structure: The shared folder and meeting table anchor the image; the board and low records shelf provide context without replacing the editable verification matrix beside the scene.
brief.details: Give the compact image readable faces, natural hand poses, muted slate upholstery, warm mineral edges and graphite furniture. Keep all paper, shelves and screens text-free.
